name: @fhirpath-lab/validator
description: TypeScript validation API for FHIR Mapping Language

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:antlr4 --outfile=dist/index.js
scripts.test: npm run build && esbuild src/test/FmlValidatorApi.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:antlr4 --outfile=dist/test.js && node --test dist/test.js
